provenance.review: machine-checked by lab.tools.check_registry (verbatim quotes, sections, ids); content reviewed by Claude where noted in review_notes

draft_notes: Only the supplied text was used. The supplied requirement prefix contains a carriage return, retained as \r in every id. Unnumbered definition headings are used verbatim as section identifiers. Referenced documents and Genesis Block constants were not supplied. DKP-8-SIMULATION and DKP-8-SIMULATION-001 are distinct reference spellings in the text; neither has been silently corrected. Boundary approach, bounded impact ranges, reversibility criteria, uncertainty propagation, and full externality exposure lack complete operational definitions. The relationship between reference-bound crossing and system-boundary crossing is ambiguous. Section 13 is expressly non-normative and generates no requirements: its stated impact of approximately 0.004 differs from the Section 5 calculation, (427.00 − 426.91)/450 = 0.0002, and its uncertainty output uses ppm while impact is described as dimensionless. The document has no separately titled Failure Modes section.

requirements.title: Restrict operation to measurement
requirements.quote: This protocol performs measurement only. It does not interpret value, intent, utility, justice, responsibility, or policy.
requirements.interpretation: Check the protocol's operations for measurement-only behavior and prohibited interpretive operations. The text does not formally distinguish measurement from interpretation, so an operation classification is needed.
requirements.criterion: Every operation performs measurement; none interprets value, intent, utility, justice, responsibility, or policy.
hypotheses_needed: Declare how operations are classified as measurement or interpretation.

requirements.title: Require physical truth input provenance
requirements.quote: All inputs to this protocol MUST originate exclusively from Physical Truth Layer outputs.
requirements.interpretation: Verify that every input has provenance identifying it as a Physical Truth Layer output. The universal wording also covers externally supplied horizons and boundary parameters, although later sections permit higher-layer involvement without explaining this provenance requirement.
requirements.criterion: Every protocol input originates exclusively from a Physical Truth Layer output.

requirements.title: Import authorized reference bounds
requirements.quote: All reference bounds Bᵢ MUST be explicitly imported from:
requirements.interpretation: Check explicit import records for every bound against the subsequent permitted sources: DKP-1-AXIOMS-001 or normatively defined Physical Truth Layer indices. This checks declared provenance, not the correctness of the unavailable source values.
requirements.criterion: Each Bᵢ has an explicit import from DKP-1-AXIOMS-001 or a normatively defined Physical Truth Layer index.
data_dependencies: Normative Physical Truth Layer index declarations

requirements.title: Bind protocol to genesis block
requirements.quote: This protocol is bound to Genesis Block #0 (2025-12-10).
requirements.interpretation: Check that the protocol declares the specified block and date as its anchor. Testing the substantive consequences of being bound requires the block's contents and a definition of the binding relationship.
requirements.criterion: The protocol is bound to Genesis Block #0 dated 2025-12-10.
data_dependencies: Genesis Block #0 contents and anchor metadata
requirements.gap: The Genesis Block contents and operational meaning of binding are not supplied. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare how Genesis Block binding is represented and enforced.

requirements.title: Exclude nonmeasurement protocol functions
requirements.quote: This protocol explicitly excludes:
requirements.interpretation: Check operations against the ensuing exclusions: optimization, scoring, weighting, channel aggregation, decision-making, enforcement, responsibility attribution, compensation, utility, and justice calculations. A declared operation taxonomy is needed to classify implementations consistently.
requirements.criterion: No protocol operation performs any function in the explicit exclusion list.
hypotheses_needed: Declare an operation taxonomy covering all explicitly excluded functions.

requirements.title: Define immutable measured state vectors
requirements.quote: An immutable, time-indexed vector of measured physical variables produced by DKP-0-ORACLE-001.
requirements.interpretation: Validate that each state vector is time-indexed, contains measured physical variables, has the specified producer, and remains unchanged after production. This checks structured measurement metadata and recorded versions.
requirements.criterion: S(t) is time-indexed, consists of measured physical variables, originates from DKP-0-ORACLE-001, and is immutable.
data_dependencies: Oracle state vectors, measurement metadata, timestamps, provenance, and version history

requirements.title: Locate baseline before evaluated change
requirements.quote: The reference physical state prior to an evaluated change.
requirements.interpretation: Given the evaluated change's temporal location, verify that the designated reference state precedes it. The text does not require a particular baseline-selection algorithm or sampling distance.
requirements.criterion: S(t₀) is the reference physical state prior to the evaluated change.
data_dependencies: Temporal location of the evaluated change

requirements.title: Locate observation after evaluated change
requirements.quote: The measured physical state after the evaluated change.
requirements.interpretation: Given the evaluated change's temporal location, verify that the observed state is measured after it. No maximum observation delay is specified.
requirements.criterion: S(t₁) is a measured physical state after the evaluated change.
data_dependencies: Temporal location of the evaluated change

requirements.title: Supply external impact evaluation horizon
requirements.quote: A time interval supplied as an external parameter defining the evaluation window.
requirements.interpretation: Check that an external time-interval parameter is supplied and used to define the evaluation window. The text does not explicitly require Δt = t₁ − t₀ or specify how it affects the impact formula.
requirements.criterion: Δt is an externally supplied time interval defining the evaluation window.
requirements.gap: The horizon is a declared input.

requirements.title: Define independent normative impact channels
requirements.quote:
A logically independent dimension of physical or informational impact.

Normatively declared impact channels include, but are not limited to:
requirements.interpretation: Check that the declared channel registry includes the seven listed channels and permits additional channels. Logical independence needs a formal model; the text also does not clearly distinguish mandatory channel support from mandatory evaluation of every channel on every run.
requirements.criterion: Channels represent logically independent physical or informational dimensions; the normative declarations include Biosphere Integrity, Atmospheric Composition, Human Health Proxies, Resource Depletion, Energy Balance, Cognitive Integrity Proxies, and Cultural Continuity Indicators.
data_dependencies: Definitions of physical and informational channel variables
hypotheses_needed: Declare a test for logical independence.
Declare whether all named channels must be evaluated on every run.

requirements.title: Define bounded channel impact metrics
requirements.quote: A channel-specific, bounded impact metric defined as normalized physical change.
requirements.interpretation: Check that each impact metric belongs to a channel and represents normalized physical change. The boundedness requirement lacks an admissible range; the crossing threshold does not establish a clipping rule.
requirements.criterion: Each Iᵢ is channel-specific, represents normalized physical change, and is bounded.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the impact range and whether boundedness refers to metric values or reference bounds.

requirements.title: Define invariant imported physical limits
requirements.quote: Invariant physical limits imported from DKP-1-AXIOMS-001 or Physical Truth Layer indices.
requirements.interpretation: Check bound metadata, import provenance, and version history for physical-limit status and invariance. This definition says physical limits, while Section 6 also permits informationally defined bounds.
requirements.criterion: Each Bᵢ is an invariant physical limit imported from DKP-1-AXIOMS-001 or a Physical Truth Layer index.
data_dependencies: Imported limit declarations, provenance, and version history

requirements.title: Define boolean irreversibility indicator
requirements.quote: A boolean indicator of physical or informational irreversibility.
requirements.interpretation: Validate that Rᵢ has boolean type and represents an irreversibility classification. Despite the heading's use of reversibility, the definition names irreversibility and does not explicitly assign meanings to True and False.
requirements.criterion: Rᵢ is a boolean indicator of physical or informational irreversibility.
requirements.gap: Physical reversibility is declared on input (the §7 criteria are not computable); polarity per H-DC-5 (F-006).

requirements.title: Define boolean boundary crossing indicator
requirements.quote: A boolean indicator of boundary-crossing impact.
requirements.interpretation: Validate that Xᵢ has boolean type and represents boundary-crossing impact. Section 8 separately requires True when a crossing is detected.
requirements.criterion: Xᵢ is a boolean indicator of boundary-crossing impact.

requirements.title: Define bounded propagated confidence intervals
requirements.quote: A bounded confidence interval propagated from Physical Truth Layer uncertainty.
requirements.interpretation: Check that Uᵢ is a bounded confidence interval with derivation lineage to Physical Truth Layer uncertainty. Verifying its numerical validity requires a confidence level and propagation method that the text does not prescribe.
requirements.criterion: Uᵢ is a bounded confidence interval propagated from Physical Truth Layer uncertainty.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the confidence level and interval construction method.

requirements.title: Compute normalized channel state differences
requirements.quote: Iᵢ = ( Sᵢ(t₁) − Sᵢ(t₀) ) / Bᵢ
requirements.interpretation: For each channel, compare the reported impact with the stated quotient using the supplied state projections and bound. The formula is undefined for Bᵢ = 0, and the text supplies neither a zero-bound policy nor a separate dependence on Δt.
requirements.criterion: Iᵢ equals (Sᵢ(t₁) − Sᵢ(t₀)) / Bᵢ wherever the quotient is defined.

requirements.title: Preserve measurable impact output properties
requirements.quote:
- unaggregated,
- dimensionless,
- auditable.
requirements.interpretation: Verify channel separation and cancellation of physical units in the impact calculation. Auditability additionally needs an evidence standard, which the text does not specify.
requirements.criterion: Each resulting impact value is unaggregated, dimensionless, and auditable.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the records required to reproduce and audit an impact value.

requirements.title: Flag normalized boundary crossing threshold
requirements.quote: If |Iᵢ| ≥ 1, a boundary crossing SHALL be flagged.
requirements.interpretation: Check that every channel whose absolute impact reaches or exceeds one has a boundary-crossing flag. This is a one-way implication and does not prohibit flagging crossings through other detection rules.
requirements.criterion: |Iᵢ| ≥ 1 implies that a boundary crossing is flagged.

requirements.title: Prohibit aggregation across impact channels
requirements.quote: No aggregation across channels is permitted.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect computation lineage for operations combining impacts from different channels into an aggregate. The prohibition applies to internal computation as well as emitted scores.
requirements.criterion: No operation aggregates across impact channels.

requirements.title: Declare qualified bounds per channel
requirements.quote: Each impact channel SHALL declare its applicable reference bounds Bᵢ.
requirements.interpretation: Verify a bound declaration for every channel and the subsequent requirements that bounds be physically or informationally defined, immutable within this protocol, and traceable to an authorized source. Source correctness is separate from declaration and traceability checks.
requirements.criterion: Every channel declares applicable Bᵢ that are physically or informationally defined, immutable within this protocol, and traceable to DKP-1-AXIOMS-001 or Physical Truth Layer indices.

requirements.title: Detect boundary approach and crossing
requirements.quote:
The protocol SHALL detect:

- boundary approach,
requirements.interpretation: Check that detection covers both boundary approach and boundary crossing, as listed after the quoted obligation. Section 5 supplies a crossing trigger, but approach lacks a threshold, distance rule, or temporal model.
requirements.criterion: The protocol detects boundary approach and boundary crossing.
data_dependencies: Channel states and imported reference bounds
requirements.gap: The approach fraction is not given (source missing).
hypotheses_needed: Declare what constitutes boundary approach.
Declare whether crossing detection is exhausted by |Iᵢ| ≥ 1.

requirements.title: Preserve bounds without reinterpretation
requirements.quote: Bounds SHALL NOT be modified, normalized, or reinterpreted.
requirements.interpretation: Compare bound values and meanings against their imports and inspect operations applied to them. The text gives no exception for normalization or reinterpretation within this protocol.
requirements.criterion: No bound is modified, normalized, or reinterpreted.
data_dependencies: Original imported bounds and their definitions

requirements.title: Evaluate formal binary reversibility criteria
requirements.quote: For each impact channel, the protocol SHALL evaluate reversibility using formal criteria.
requirements.interpretation: Verify that every channel has evaluated criteria that are explicit, physically or informationally grounded, and binary in output. The examples are optional and do not supply a complete required classification algorithm.
requirements.criterion: Every channel evaluates explicit, physically or informationally grounded formal reversibility criteria yielding binary output.
data_dependencies: Physical Truth Layer evidence relevant to reversibility
requirements.gap: The formal criterion is a declared flag.
hypotheses_needed: Declare formal reversibility criteria for each channel.
Declare how evidence establishes the criteria's grounding and boolean interpretation.

requirements.title: Exclude subjective reversibility assessments
requirements.quote: Subjective or intent-based assessments are forbidden.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect reversibility assessment inputs and rules for subjective or intent-based judgments. Intent-based dependencies can be traced, but identifying all subjective assessments requires an explicit classification rule.
requirements.criterion: No reversibility assessment is subjective or intent-based.
hypotheses_needed: Declare how subjective and intent-based assessments are identified.

requirements.title: Distinguish internal and external impact
requirements.quote: The protocol SHALL distinguish between internal and external impact.
requirements.interpretation: Check impact classification against the applicable system boundary. The text does not specify how spatial, informational, or mixed impacts are mapped to internal and external categories.
requirements.criterion: Detected impacts are distinguished as internal or external relative to the applicable system boundary.
requirements.gap: Spill beyond the boundary is declared.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the internal and external classification rule, including treatment of impacts spanning both.

requirements.title: Default system boundary to planetary
requirements.quote: System boundary SHALL default to planetary scale unless explicitly narrowed by higher-layer protocols.
requirements.interpretation: Verify that the boundary is planetary unless an explicit higher-layer narrowing exists. This checks declared boundary scope and authorization; the text does not provide a planetary geometry.
requirements.criterion: Without explicit higher-layer narrowing, system boundary scope is planetary; any narrowing is explicitly supplied by a higher-layer protocol.

requirements.title: Set externality upon detected crossing
requirements.quote: Any detected boundary crossing SHALL set Xᵢ = True.
requirements.interpretation: Verify that a detected crossing sets the corresponding channel's externality flag to True. The text does not clearly state whether boundary crossing includes every reference-bound threshold crossing, every system-boundary crossing, or both.
requirements.criterion: Every applicable detected boundary crossing sets the corresponding Xᵢ to True.
requirements.gap: Reads 'boundary crossing' in §8 as the §5 flag; system-boundary scope is not modelled.
hypotheses_needed: Declare which crossing types trigger Xᵢ = True.

requirements.title: Assume exposure without explicit boundary
requirements.quote: Absence of an explicit boundary definition SHALL be treated as full externality exposure.
requirements.interpretation: Check that missing explicit boundary definitions trigger full externality exposure. The text does not define that exposure state or establish whether it means setting all Xᵢ to True, and it does not explain how this rule interacts with the planetary default.
requirements.criterion: If an explicit boundary definition is absent, the protocol treats the case as full externality exposure.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the representation and consequences of full externality exposure.
Declare whether the planetary default counts as an explicit boundary definition.

requirements.title: Propagate uncertainty into every channel
requirements.quote: Measurement uncertainty from Physical Truth Layer inputs SHALL be propagated into each impact channel.
requirements.interpretation: Verify uncertainty lineage for every channel and recompute envelopes under a declared propagation method. The listed methods and ±3σ example are illustrative permissions, not mandatory algorithms or confidence levels.
requirements.criterion: Each channel receives propagated measurement uncertainty from its Physical Truth Layer inputs.
data_dependencies: Physical Truth Layer measurement uncertainties and dependence information
hypotheses_needed: Declare an uncertainty propagation method, dependence assumptions, and confidence level.

requirements.title: Require deterministic uncertainty propagation
requirements.quote: Propagation SHALL be deterministic.
requirements.interpretation: Compare propagation outputs for identical complete inputs and fixed configuration. Repeated-run comparison checks observed determinism; establishing determinism for all possible inputs additionally requires a specified computational model.
requirements.criterion: Identical complete propagation inputs and configuration always produce identical uncertainty outputs.
hypotheses_needed: Declare all propagation state, including any random seeds, and the scope over which determinism is tested.

requirements.title: Preserve detected impact despite uncertainty
requirements.quote: Uncertainty SHALL NOT be used to suppress, downgrade, or invalidate detected impact.
requirements.interpretation: Trace whether uncertainty causes a detected impact to be omitted, reduced in status, or invalidated. Suppression can be checked through lineage, but downgrade and invalidation need declared impact-status semantics.
requirements.criterion: No detected impact is suppressed, downgraded, or invalidated because of uncertainty.
hypotheses_needed: Declare how suppression, downgrade, and invalidation are recognized and causally attributed to uncertainty.

requirements.title: Emit required fields per channel
requirements.quote: For each impact channel *i*, the protocol outputs:
requirements.interpretation: Validate that every channel output includes all five subsequently listed fields: Iᵢ, Bᵢ, Rᵢ, Xᵢ, and Uᵢ. This checks required field presence; their substantive correctness is governed by the other provisions.
requirements.criterion: For every channel i, output Iᵢ, Bᵢ, Rᵢ, Xᵢ, and Uᵢ.

requirements.title: Exclude aggregated impact score outputs
requirements.quote: No aggregated impact score SHALL be produced.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect output fields and their derivation for aggregated impact scores. This specifically constrains produced outputs in addition to the broader aggregation prohibition.
requirements.criterion: No produced output is an aggregated impact score.
requirements.gap: Where RED combines its channels is not defined: UNKNOWN for a single delta (F-015).

requirements.title: Prevent prohibited higher layer interference
requirements.quote:
- suppress impact channels,
- override reversibility or externality flags,
- inject valuation, weighting, responsibility, or optimization logic.
requirements.interpretation: Check higher-layer actions for all four listed prohibitions, including alteration of reference bounds in the preceding bullet. Detecting injected valuation, responsibility, or optimization logic requires a declared classification of such logic.
requirements.criterion: No higher-layer protocol alters bounds, suppresses channels, overrides Rᵢ or Xᵢ, or injects valuation, weighting, responsibility, or optimization logic.
data_dependencies: Higher-layer action logs and interface payloads
hypotheses_needed: Declare how higher-layer actions and injected logic are classified against each prohibition.

requirements.title: Classify isolation violations as critical
requirements.quote: Violation constitutes a critical architectural breach.
requirements.interpretation: Given a detected violation of the cross-layer isolation invariant, verify classification as a critical architectural breach. The text prescribes no additional response, recovery action, or shutdown.
requirements.criterion: Every violation of the Section 11 isolation prohibitions constitutes a critical architectural breach.

requirements.title: Use controlled protocol change procedure
requirements.quote: This protocol is changed only through the controlled procedure of DKP-4-UPGRADE-001: proposal, simulation under DKP-8-SIMULATION-001, audit under DKP-8-AUDIT-001, acceptance conditions, activation window and rollback.
requirements.interpretation: Check normative changes for evidence of the named upgrade procedure and its listed components. The referenced documents are needed to determine acceptance, activation timing, and rollback rules; the text does not require every upgrade actually to be rolled back.
requirements.criterion: Every normative protocol change follows DKP-4-UPGRADE-001, including proposal, specified simulation and audit, acceptance conditions, activation window, and rollback provisions.
requirements.gap: Declared stages of the change; the procedure itself is upgrade_lifecycle.
hypotheses_needed: If simulating without the references, declare provisional workflow, acceptance, activation-window, and rollback rules.

requirements.title: Require modification identity and revalidation
requirements.quote:
- a new protocol identifier,
- explicit declaration of incompatibility,
- full-system revalidation under DKP-8-SIMULATION.
requirements.interpretation: For each modification, verify a new identifier, an explicit incompatibility declaration, and full-system revalidation. The later presentation-only exception appears to limit the otherwise universal wording, and the revalidation reference is spelled DKP-8-SIMULATION without the -001 suffix.
requirements.criterion: Every applicable modification has a new protocol identifier, explicitly declares incompatibility, and undergoes full-system revalidation under DKP-8-SIMULATION.
hypotheses_needed: Treat presentation-only corrections satisfying the later exception as outside these modification requirements.
Declare provisional full-system revalidation criteria if the referenced procedure is unavailable.

requirements.title: Record presentation corrections by date
requirements.quote: Presentation-only corrections that do not change normative content are not Upgrades (DKP-4-UPGRADE-001 §3); they are recorded only by the "Last updated" date of this document.
requirements.interpretation: Determine whether a correction changes normative content; qualifying corrections must be excluded from Upgrades and recorded through the document's update date. The document has a last_updated front-matter field but no literal Last updated field, and semantic equivalence of normative content is not mechanically defined.
requirements.criterion: A presentation-only correction preserving normative content is not an Upgrade and is recorded only by the document's Last updated date.
hypotheses_needed: Declare how presentation-only changes are distinguished from normative changes.
Treat last_updated as the referenced Last updated date.
Declare how date-only correction recording coexists with edition digest publication.

requirements.title: Publish canonical edition integrity digests
requirements.quote: Edition integrity: the SHA-256 digest of the canonical source of each published edition is listed in `SHA256SUMS.txt` of the canonical repository (github.com/anahronic/World).
requirements.interpretation: For each published edition, compute SHA-256 over its identified canonical source and compare it with the repository manifest entry. This is decidable when the canonical source bytes, edition inventory, and manifest are supplied.
requirements.criterion: For each published edition, SHA256(canonical source) is listed in SHA256SUMS.txt in github.com/anahronic/World.
data_dependencies: Canonical source bytes for every published edition
requirements.gap: Checked on the pinned commit and on simulated releases, not on the published site.
